content:
maya: Pelican Telecom (top-10 telco) just escalated. They want Private deployment in EU + SSO + a custom model variant by Aug 31. Contract pushes for 99.9% SLA and a go-live milestone with penalties. Can we commit?

tony (Eng Lead): Need clarification on "custom model variant" — do they mean fine-tuning or just config/weight selection? Also EU region + VPC peering + SAML SSO adds infra work. Rough ETA if accepted: 6–8 weeks after spec freeze.

sasha (Solutions Eng): They want model tweaks (domain tokens + bias controls), not full fine-tune. Could probably support via prompt-template + config flags for initial delivery. SSO is straightforward (SAML) but CORS and peering require network approvals.

ellen (CSM): Pelican's CSM says Aug 31 is a hard date tied to marketing. They've hinted they can shift to mid-Sep if we add a 2-week pilot window.

jordan (Account Exec): Contract draft includes a delivery SLA and a $Xk credit if missed. Sales can push for Sep 15 but need engineering sign-off. Also they want encryption keys in their KMS (customer-managed keys).

ton y (typo) tony: Customer-managed keys implies KMS/HSM integration and key rotation policy. That's critical path. If we scope to not-inside-HSM initial release, we can deliver faster but they'd push back.

kevin (VP Product): Prioritization call — this is high ARR but non-trivial infra. Proposal: Offer a two-phase commitment: Phase 1 (by Sep 15): Private deployment in EU, VPC peering, SAML SSO, pinned open model variant, pilot with acceptance tests. Phase 2 (by Nov 15): KMS customer-key integration + optional model customization (managed fine-tune). We put Phase 2 as paid add-on with separate SLA.

maya: That aligns with what I was thinking. Need definitive acceptance criteria for Phase 1: 
- SAML SSO working end-to-end for 5 test accounts 
- VPC peering and encrypted data paths verified 
- Latency baseline tests: p95 request latency < 800ms for target flows 
- Canary pilot with 2 customers for 2 weeks and sign-off from CSM

ellen: I'll get the test accounts and run the acceptance checklist. We should add a rollback plan in case performance regressions appear.

tony (Eng Lead): For canary we want throttles and automated fallback to hosted model. Also need a runbook for on-call.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: New ticket created: INF-4321 Private EU peering config. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4321

sasha: I'll scope the work items and deps: network (peering), infra (installer + config), auth (SAML), keys (deferred), perf testing (load harness). Estimated eng effort: 3 Sprints across 3 teams if parallelized.

jordan: Sales will propose the two-phase MSA amendment. We'll push for Sep 15 Phase 1 and set a paid Phase 2. If eng can't meet Sep 15, I'll negotiate a pilot-first clause (pilot + extended pilot fees).

kevin: Decision: greenlight with constraints — Phase 1 target Sep 15; Phase 2 target Nov 15. Eng to come back with exact sprint plan by EOD tomorrow. Sales and Legal to prepare amendment with pilot terms.

maya: Thanks. @tony please post the sprint plan here by EOD tomorrow. @ellen loop in Pelican CSM and grab test accounts. Any blockers flag ASAP. :thumbsup:
